profile.headline: Oracle Applications Consultant
profile.summary: Oracle Applications Developer specializing in implementation, upgrade, analysis, design, development, and support of Oracle E-Business Suite and related Oracle technologies. Experience with development, business analysis, training, management, and lead roles covering a variety of modules including Order Management, Manufacturing, Financials, CRM, and HRMS across a variety of industries. Involved in multiple Oracle 11i and R12 implementations and upgrades.
